# iru_custom_profile (List Resource)

Lists existing `iru_custom_profile` objects for `terraform query`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
list "iru_custom_profile" "all" {
  provider         = iru
  include_resource = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Only list custom profiles with exactly this name.
